# Deepriton

**Deepriton** is a 液態 (連續泵取) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/zh-TW/formats/ore-fields/).

## 開採

| Property | 數值 |
|---|---|
| 單次開採量 | 450 |
| 開採方式 | 液態 (連續泵取) |
| 觸發效果 | 不需要 |
| 地質掃描文檔 | definition 8699 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
